title: Correct fall time
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the time for the flowerpot to fall from height H to the truck roof height using h = H - h₁ and t = √(2h/g).

title: Part (1) conclusion
description: Essential: Student correctly determines whether the truck will be hit by comparing the truck's displacement (v₀t) with the initial horizontal distance L₂.

title: Reaction time displacement
description: Important: Student accounts for the truck's motion during the driver's reaction time Δt by calculating x₂ = v₀Δt.

title: Kinematic equation setup
description: Important: Student sets up the correct kinematic equation for the truck's accelerated motion: d + L₁ = v₀(t-Δt) + ½a(t-Δt)².

title: Part (2) acceleration
description: Essential: Student correctly solves for the minimum acceleration a and provides the numerical answer with proper units.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Student makes sign errors in displacement calculations or incorrectly handles the relative positions of truck and flowerpot.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units throughout calculations and includes units in final answers.

title: Free-fall assumption
description: Optional: Student explicitly states or correctly applies the assumption of free-fall motion for the flowerpot.
